cover.title: 5 niche ways to turn chatgpt visitors into paying customers

inner.title: group the ai sources
inner.body: ga4 has no default chatgpt channel, so create a group for chatgpt.com, perplexity.ai, claude.ai and gemini.google.com. until you do, these visits hide inside generic referral.

inner.title: read the landing pages
inner.body: open the top landing pages from ai referrals. ahrefs found only about 10% of its most-cited pages overlap with its top chatgpt traffic pages, so the page that gets cited may not be the one that gets visited.

inner.title: make checking easy
inner.body: put reviews, case studies and a comparison table near the buy button. buyers often verify a chatgpt pick on google first, and last-click credits the sale to google.

inner.title: lead with price and proof
inner.body: a/b test a landing page that opens with your price and your best proof. chatgpt tends to cite blog posts over product pages, so visitors arrive without either.

inner.title: track your own rate
inner.body: a 973-site study found chatgpt converting 13% below organic search. a later 94-site sample found 1.81% against 1.39%, so borrow neither number and measure your own.

you close the sale.
